response.original_title: BRUCKNER, A.: Symphonies (Complete) (Bruckner 11) (Vienna Philharmonic, Thielemann) (5-Blu-ray Disc Box Set)
response.overview: Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra Christian Thielemann, conductor  Recorded live at the Wiener Musikverein, February 2019 (Symphonies Nos. 2, 8), November 2020 (Symphony No. 3), February–March 2021 (Symphonies in F, Nos. 0, 1, 5), April 2022 (Symphony No. 6) / Salzburg Festival, 2020 (Symphony No. 4), August 2021 (Symphony No. 7), 2022 (Symphony No. 9)  Bonus: - “Discovering Bruckner”, Christian Thielemann in conversation with Johannes-Leopold Mayer on each Bruckner Symphony
response.title: BRUCKNER, A.: Symphonies (Complete) (Bruckner 11) (Vienna Philharmonic, Thielemann) (5-Blu-ray Disc Box Set)
